svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Trackside Editorial, Red Header
svg.desc: An automotive editorial website concept uses direct transparent logos on red header and footer bands, oversized navy Futura typography in the photograph's open sky, a slim left discovery column and an architectural call to action. The full-width circuit photo remains untinted and the Ferrari's hood, interior and wheels remain clear. A bottom rail names the featured car and provides collection navigation. One white section introduces discovery, saving and comparison.

g.text: A collection that starts with a feeling.
Explore cars that catch your eye.
Put your favorites side by side.
